title: Chief of Staff - CCO (m/w/d)
description:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. title: Junior Customer Success Manager
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Hejsa! 👋   At du har fundet vej hertil, betyder nok, at du vil vide mere om rollen som  Junior   Customer Success Manager . Det er vi glade for - vi mangler nemlig dig! Men først får du lige en kort intro til, hvem vi er, og hvorfor vi gør det, vi gør.  Resights blev skabt med en ret simpel idé: At samle ejendomsdata ét sted, så vores kunder kan spare tid og træffe bedre beslutninger. Slut med rodede regneark og mavefornemmelser 😵‍💫 Siden da har vi, i tæt samarbejde med vores kunder, udviklet platformen massivt. I dag bruges Resights til alt fra at finde investeringsejendomme og analysere markeder og transaktioner samt finde nye fremtidige projekter. Fællesnævneren er ejendomsdata og vores mission om at gøre det muligt for kunderne at drive endnu mere forretning.  Så ja, det  er  Resights. Men i virkeligheden er det vigtigste de 51 mennesker bag platformen - et hold af passionerede nørder og teamspillere, der på fem år har bygget en hurtigt voksende scaleup med over 1.400 kunder. Og vigtigst af alt: Vi har haft det virkelig sjovt undervejs!   Om dig   Vi tror ikke på lange kravlister, men vi har stadig forventninger til dig! Dygtighed kan komme både med erfaring og med frisk energi – og vi værdsætter begge dele. Når det er sagt, vil drømmescenariet være, at du har 1-2 års erfaring fra B2B i en kundevendt rolle, hvor du er vant til at forstå og håndtere kundebehov eller på anden vis har håndteret kundedialoger.   Din mission   Der er ét afgørende succeskriterium i rollen: At vores kunder får det fulde udbytte af Resights og forbliver abonnenter.  Hvordan gør vi så det? Lad os sætte nogle ord på dine opgaver som Junior Customer Success Manager.  Du får ansvaret for din egen portefølje på ca. 300 kunder, som du skal sikre får glæde af Resights i deres daglige arbejde. Nogle kræver kun en kort onboarding, andre har brug for mere løbende sparring. Derfor er din proaktivitet nøglen. Du skal kunne arbejde struktureret og samtidig have mange bolde i luften.  Du kan selvf

title: Head of Marketing (m/f/d)
description:
Your priority for 2027 is pipeline. You turn marketing into a predictable source of qualified pipeline in two motions. Net new: winning new enterprise logos in Europe and the US. Expansion: growing with our existing clients into new business units, countries, and use cases, with a pipeline target you share with Customer Success and Account Management. Brand, content, and events all matter, and each is measured by what it contributes to these two motions. In the interview process, you will walk us through how you would build this pipeline in your first 12 months.
Tasks

Requirements

Benefits

About the role (Munich, onsite):

You take over our marketing team and own pipeline growth, for net new logos and across our existing enterprise client base. Retorio roughly triples in size every year, sells to large enterprises, and already generates around 40% of its pipeline organically. Your mandate is to build a scalable lead generation engine that works in Europe, our home market where we want to be the clear number one, and in the US, where we have opened an office in New York.

You do this with deliberately modest ad budgets and a small team (today one events specialist and one lead generation specialist) that will grow over time. Our growth strategy is to let our customers speak for us: reference stories, video case studies, and communities in which decision makers at large enterprises share their use cases and results and attract their peers.

To support that pipeline, you also establish Retorio as the credible, science-based voice in an increasingly competitive AI sales coaching category, and you give the brand an external appearance that is professional enough for enterprise buyers and distinct enough to stand out. You report directly to the founder/Co-CEO.

Tasks

  • Owning the 2027 marketing pipeline targets (MQLs, SQLs, and sourced pipeline) for net new logos and expansion revenue, in Europe

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your role

title: Account Executive
description:
At Almetra, we’re on a mission to reinvent how factories work.

We help manufacturers - one of the most essential and overlooked sectors of our economy - run better. Every car, wind turbine, medical device, and washing machine comes from a factory. But factories today are running out of people. They struggle with efficiency, safety, and quality - and they desperately need better tools to understand what’s happening on the shop floor.

That’s where we come in. Almetra builds AI-powered computer vision systems that give manufacturers deep visibility into how their production lines actually run - and the insights to improve them. We don’t sell ads or marketing software. We help real factories solve real problems.

You’ll be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale from an early-stage startup into a category-defining company.

Why join us

  • Mission with real impact. You’ll help the world’s most essential companies stay competitive, sustainable, and safe in a world of labor shortages and rising costs.

  • Category-defining moment. With global manufacturers already deploying Almetra and fresh funding, we’re scaling fast across Europe and the US.

  • Big deals, big influence. You’ll lead 6-digit enterprise sales cycles, shape our go-to-market motion, and be a core driver of our revenue engine.

  • High bar, high trust. You’ll work directly with founders, product, and engineering to design solutions and expand strategic accounts.

What you’ll do

title: Customer Success Manager
description: About AskYourTeam   Founded in Aotearoa NZ in 2014, AskYourTeam helps leaders listen to their people, customers and communities, then act on what matters most.     Now, more than 200 organisations and governments across New Zealand and Australia use our platforms. VOICE captures and analyses feedback from staff and stakeholders. CODA, our decision intelligence platform, is designed to help councils understand what their community wants, not just the loudest voices. description: Job Overview   We are looking for an experienced Cards Portfolio Growth & Optimization Manager to join an exciting project with a leading financial institution in Doha, Qatar. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.  With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
